runtime.note: Framework-dependent single-file today. Packaged builds publish --self-contained so a node needs no .NET runtime.
runtime.warning: Discord.Net does not work under InvariantGlobalization=true — the guild never loads and the bot posts nothing, silently. Do not add that property to this project.

commands.name: kgsm
commands.why: slash commands reach the engine through kgsm-lib

services.name: kgsm-watchdog.service
services.why: lifecycle slash commands act through it
services.without: read-only commands and announcements work; start/stop/restart fail

services.name: kgsm-assistant-service.service
services.why: backs the conversational half of the bot
services.without: slash commands, channels and announcements are unaffected — there is deliberately no fallback engine behind the chat surface

network.why: the bot is a Discord gateway client
network.without: the bot cannot connect at all

secrets.note: Never shipped in any package. Seeding it is part of node bootstrap.
